title: Prescriptions Terms: Grace Days for Patients Who Refill Regularly Before Travel
content:
A patient who refills a Kestrel Prescriptions record regularly receives vacation override grace days on a travel refill.

## Terms

The vacation override grace days count the refills dispensed on the prescription in the last 12 months:

- **three or more** refills give **7 grace days**;
- **one or two** refills give **3 grace days**;
- **none** gives no grace days.

The grace days are taken off the days of medication still on hand from the most recent refill, never below zero, and only those remaining on-hand days are deducted from the vacation override days supply.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Refills in the last 12 months | Grace days | Days on hand before grace | Days on hand after grace |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 7 | 20 | 13 |
| 2 | 3 | 20 | 17 |
| 0 | 0 | 20 | 20 |
| 3 | 7 | 5 | 0 (never below zero) |

**Does the original fill count?** No; the count is of refills dispensed on the prescription.
